working: In photorespiration, RuBisCO acts as an oxygenase and adds O2 to RuBP (a 5C compound). This splits it into one molecule of 3-phosphoglycerate (3C) and one molecule of 2-phosphoglycolate (2C). PEP, oxaloacetate and malate belong to C4/CAM carbon fixation, not to this reaction. So X is 2-phosphoglycolate.
